designSummary: Descriptive monitoring of a new service against a pre-opening baseline; no hypothesis test.
sampleSize: All referred patients are included; about 120 patients are expected in the first year at 6 nurse hours per week. At 120 patients, a proportion of 60 percent has a 95 percent confidence interval half-width of about 9 percentage points, enough to see whether the clinic is far from the baseline of about 29 percent. No sample size calculation is needed because no comparison is tested.
primaryAnalysis: Proportion at half target dose or more of all indicated classes at 6 months after referral, with a 95 percent Wilson interval, reported by monthly referral cohort and against the pre-opening baseline.
secondaryAnalysis: Counts and rates of hyperkalaemia, symptomatic hypotension and eGFR falls per 100 patients titrated; missed visits by deprivation fifth; heart failure admissions within 12 months, described.
missingData: Patients without a 6-month dose record are counted as not at target and reported separately; no imputation.
multiplicity: One main measure; other measures are descriptive.
software: Spreadsheet kept by the lead nurse; figures checked by the clinical lead.
overfittingGuards: No subgroup claims beyond deprivation fifth
Every referred patient in the denominator
summary: Descriptive monitoring with confidence intervals; about 120 patients in year one.
